subject: Party Creation
text: Starting a new game requires choosing a character class for each of the four party members.

evidence.quote: When you start a new game, you have four characters for which you must choose a character class.

subject: Fighter
text: Fighters can equip the most powerful weapons and armor in the game and generally have the highest HP.

evidence.quote: Can use the most powerful weapons and armor in the game. IMHO, every party you send through the game should have at least one of these. They usually have the best HPs.

subject: Thief
text: Thieves have moderate attack power and the highest Agility ratings, but cannot use as many weapons as fighters.

evidence.quote: Thieves aren't as strong as fighters and can't use as many weapons, but they are useful in getting your party out of sticky situations. They have the best Agility ratings, and moderate attacks.

subject: Black Belt
text: The Black Belt possesses the strongest attack power when fighting unarmed, and equipping weapons actually weakens him later in the game.

evidence.quote: The Black Belt is *THE* fighter, with *THE* best attacks _unarmed_. Arming him actually weakens him somewhat, especially later on. They have HP ratings (usually) second only to the Fighter.

subject: Red Mage
text: Red Mages can cast both White and Black Magic and fight reasonably well, but cannot learn the most powerful spells.

evidence.quote: Red Mages can learn both White and Black Magic spells, and can even fight fairly well. However, a Red Mage cannot learn some of the most powerful spells.

subject: White Mage
text: White Mages can cast any White magic spell, but are poor physical fighters.

evidence.quote: Can use any White magic spells, a poor fighter, however.

subject: Black Mage
text: Black Mages can cast any Black magic spell, but have weak physical combat capabilities.

evidence.quote: Can use any Black magic spells, an even worse fighter.

subject: White Mage
text: White Mages do not gain any attack magic until they acquire the FADE spell.

evidence.quote: The Black Mages at least had the benefit of attack magic, something White Mages don't get, until FADE.

subject: Invisible Man
text: An invisible man can be encountered while exploring inside Castle Coneria.

evidence.quote: First, enter the castle. You can walk around the castle if you wish, talking to the people. (You can find an invisible man if you search around.)

subject: King of Coneria
text: Speaking to the King in Castle Coneria reveals that Princess Sara has been kidnapped by Garland.

evidence.quote: Or just walk straight up into the stairs, and from there to the King. Talk to him to learn the Princess has been kidnapped by some dude called Garland.

subject: Fighter
text: The recommended starting weapon and armor for a Fighter in Coneria are a Rapier and Chain Armor.

evidence.quote: Fighter |Rapier |Chain Armor

subject: Black Belt
text: The recommended initial purchase for a Black Belt in Coneria consists of Iron Nunchucks and Wooden Armor.

evidence.quote: Bl. Belt*|Iron Nchks|Wooden Armor

subject: Thief
text: The recommended initial equipment for a Thief in Coneria is a Rapier and Wooden Armor.

evidence.quote: Thief |Rapier |Wooden Armor

subject: Red Mage
text: The recommended starting equipment for a Red Mage in Coneria is a Rapier and Chain Armor.

evidence.quote: R. Mage |Rapier |Chain Armor

subject: White Mage
text: The recommended starting equipment for a White Mage in Coneria is an Iron Hammer and Cloth.

evidence.quote: Wh. Mage |Iron Hmmr |Cloth

subject: Black Mage
text: The recommended starting equipment for a Black Mage in Coneria is a Small Dagger and Cloth.

evidence.quote: Bl. Mage |Small Dgr.|Cloth

subject: Black Belt
text: An unarmed Black Belt calculates attack rating as 2 times level, and performs 4 hits per turn once hit rate reaches 32%.

evidence.quote: An unarmed BB's attack rating is always 2 x level, and he can do 4 hits a turn after he reaches 32% for hit % rating.

subject: Magic Spells
text: Starting level 1 magic spells in Coneria cost 100 GP each, including CURE, HARM, FIRE, LIT, and SLEP.

evidence.quote: CURE is a MUST, if you have a white or red mage. You should also get HARM, if you have a white mage. For black mages get FIRE and LIT, and SLEP. Of course, with spells at 100 GP a pop, you're going to run out of gold before you get all that.

subject: Cap
text: A Cap can be found as the first treasure chest along the clockwise outer perimeter of the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote: Now head north until you reach the Temple of Fiends (the ruins). Wander around the perimeter clockwise. You should find three treasures in this order: a Cap (equip to whoever has the lowest Absorb rating; check your Status screen), a Cabin and a Heal potion.

subject: Cabin
text: A Cabin is found as the second chest when circling the perimeter of the Temple of Fiends clockwise.

evidence.quote: Wander around the perimeter clockwise. You should find three treasures in this order: a Cap (equip to whoever has the lowest Absorb rating; check your Status screen), a Cabin and a Heal potion.

subject: Heal Potion
text: A Heal potion is found as the third chest along the clockwise perimeter of the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote: Wander around the perimeter clockwise. You should find three treasures in this order: a Cap (equip to whoever has the lowest Absorb rating; check your Status screen), a Cabin and a Heal potion.

subject: Garland
text: Garland is confronted by heading straight through the central door of the Temple of Fiends, where he is vulnerable to the FIRE spell.

evidence.quote: Then head back to the Temple, but this time head straight up through the door. Talk to Garland, who will fling a few insults your way and then attack... Black or Red mages should flame the sucker (with the FIRE spell, not with E-Mail)

subject: Princess Sara
text: After rescuing Princess Sara from Garland and returning to Castle Coneria, talking to the Princess rewards the party with the Lute.

evidence.quote: After beating Garland, talk to the princess. You'll be teleported back to the castle. Talk to the king and to the princess, and the princess will give you the Lute.

subject: King of Coneria
text: Following Garland's defeat, the King of Coneria expresses his gratitude by ordering a bridge built to the mainland.

evidence.quote: The King will show his gratitude by ordering a bridge built to the mainland. Rest at the Inn, and then head for the bridge.

subject: Matoya's Cave
text: Exploring Matoya's Cave north of the Coneria bridge yields two Heal potions and a Pure potion.

evidence.quote: Cross the bridge and head north until you find a cave. Enter the cave and explore. You will find two heal potions, a pure potion, a bunch of talking brooms that say, "TCELES B HSUP."

subject: Matoya
text: Matoya the Witch resides in her cave having lost her Crystal, which formerly granted her sight.

evidence.quote: You'll also find Matoya the Witch, who seems to have lost her Crystal, which allowed her to see. You can't do much for her now, however.

subject: World Map
text: Holding down the B button and pressing SELECT displays the world map with the party's current location and destination points.

evidence.quote: In case you didn't figure out the broom's clue, when you leave the cave, hold down B on the controller and push SELECT. This will bring up a world map, showing your current location.

subject: Pirates
text: In Pravoka, talking to the pirate captain on the west side of town triggers a battle against a crew of nine pirates.

evidence.quote: Stay at the inn, and then talk to the head pirate on the west side of town. He'll order his crew of nine to attack!

subject: Pirates
text: Defeating the nine pirates in Pravoka awards 360 GP and a ship docked just outside the town.

evidence.quote: Winning nets you 360 GP and a ship. It's waiting for you in the dock just outside of town, but don't leave just yet.

subject: Pravoka Weapons
text: Pravoka sells Gloves, Wooden Shields, Scimitars, Iron Armor, and either a Short Sword or Hand Axe for 550 GP.

evidence.quote: First, buy everyone a pair of gloves. Then buy fighters a wooden shield... buy a Scimitar if you have any thieves, and either a Short Sword or a Hand Axe for fighters. They both cost the same (550 GP)... Also pick up some iron armor.

subject: Pravoka Magic
text: Pravoka sells the Black magic spells ICE and SLOW, and the White magic spells MUTE, ALIT, and INVS.

evidence.quote: As for magic, be sure to pick up ICE and SLOW (black), and MUTE, ALIT, and INVS (white). Red Mages should pick up at least ICE and MUTE.

subject: Peninsula of Power
text: Heading east into the mountains from Pravoka and continuing to the northernmost tip of the two-block-wide peninsula encounters high-level monsters like FrWOLFs, GIANTs, and TYROs due to a programming quirk.

evidence.quote: If you're really feeling lucky, then leave the town, head east into the mountains, then as far north as you can go. Due to a bug in the game, the top part of this (two-block wide) peninsula contains FrWOLFs, GIANTs, TYROs, and other relatively stronger enemies.
